Maya (AE): Hey team — BlueWave Finance wants to kick off a short POC next week. Main asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning for ~4k users, RBAC mapping by AD groups, and domain isolation. Can we confirm constraints?
Darren (SE): Quick answers: SAML + SCIM are supported in Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports SAML for SSO but SCIM provisioning for large orgs needs Dedicated or Private for webhook reliability.
Priya (Security): They also sent a security questionnaire — IdP metadata, SAML signing cert rotation policy, SCIM TLS cert pinning question, and requirement for domain ownership proof (DNS).
Alex (Eng): For RBAC: we support role mapping via SCIM group -> Redwood role during provisioning. We can also ship a small mapping lambda if they want custom claims mapping.
Maya (AE): Pricing question from buyer: is SCIM included or an add-on in Dedicated? They asked if SCIM sync counts towards tokens or is metered differently.
Darren (SE): SCIM provisioning itself is not token-metered. If they use Dedicated, SCIM endpoints are part of the control plane license. If they need near-real-time user sync at scale we should recommend Dedicated with burst capacity.
Priya (Security): They want to enforce SAML 2.0 with signed assertions + encrypted assertions. We support signed assertions; encrypted assertions require extra config on our side — we can enable it but need to schedule a short Ops change window.
Maya (AE): Can we list the exact artifacts they need to provide for the security questionnaire? I can send a checklist to them.
Darren (SE): Checklist we usually send:
- IdP metadata XML (entityID, SSO URL, x509 cert)
- SCIM base URL + service account credentials (client id/secret) or SAML-backed provisioning details
- AD group names to role map (CSV)
- DNS TXT record to prove domain ownership for domain-scoped provisioning
- Desired role hierarchy + any custom role names
- Estimated SCIM write cadence (sync intervals) and total users

Priya (Security): Add:
- SOC2 / ISO attestation (we'll provide our compliance pack)
- SAML cert rotation window expectations (we rotate every 90 days by default; note if they have stricter policies we can align)
- Whether they require HSM/KMS for signing keys (we have KMS integrations in Private)

Alex (Eng): Technical blocker note: BlueWave wants tenant isolation by domain and per-tenant audit logs retained for 12 months. Audit retention is an enterprise add-on for hosted; for Dedicated/Private we can meet 12 months with the correct storage tier.
Maya (AE): Great — I told them we can cover audit retention in Dedicated quote. They're sensitive to cost. Any short suggestions on pricing levers?
Darren (SE): Pricing levers: reduce peak throughput SLOs, use a quantized model variant, enable prefix caching, and limit SCIM sync frequency. We can also stage with Hosted for eval (no SCIM), then move to Dedicated for full provisioning.
Priya (Security): For the questionnaire: they asked about RBAC separation of duties — we should provide sample RBAC mapping and mention support for custom admin roles + logging of admin actions.
Maya (AE): Can someone draft the checklist + a short email template I can send to buyer? I need it before EOD tomorrow.
Darren (SE): I'll drop a short checklist and the snippet for role mapping.
Alex (Eng): I'll add the DevOps window note for encrypted assertions and the audit retention SLA text.
Priya (Security): I'll attach the compliance pack and security answers (SAML cert rotation, TLS policies).
Maya (AE): Awesome. One more: they asked if we support SCIM filtering (only sync users in certain OUs). Is that possible?
Darren (SE): Yes — SCIM filtering by group/OUs is supported; you can either do source-side filtering in IdP or we can accept a filter expression. For large orgs we recommend IdP filtering.
Maya (AE): Cool. I'll coordinate dates for the POC and ask for the IdP metadata + CSV mapping. Thanks all :pray:
DeployBot: Scheduled maintenance window noted: ops-change-encrypted-assertions will need a 1-hour deploy slot; proposed slot Thu 02:00 UTC.
Maya (AE): Noted. I'll ask them if Thu 02:00 UTC works.
Darren (SE): If they prefer not to wait for encryption we can proceed with signed-only for the POC and enable encryption for production.
Priya (Security): Also double-check data residency—BlueWave asked about EU data residency. For Dedicated we can pin region to eu-west-1; for Private we can advise on on-prem.
Maya (AE): Sending checklist now. I'll post back once they reply with metadata.
Darren (SE): TL;DR action items: (1) Draft checklist (Darren) (2) Draft Ops window note (Alex) (3) Compliance pack answers (Priya) (4) Confirm pricing levers for AE (Maya).
Maya (AE): Perfect. Closing loop later.
